name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with arms extended overhead.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor, engaging your core.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Keep your arms straight and by your ears, legs straight and together.
Your body should form a slight curve or 'hollow' shape.
Only your lower back and glutes should be in contact with the floor.
Keep your chin tucked slightly and look at your thighs.
Hold this position for the prescribed time while maintaining tension.
If too difficult, bend your knees or keep your arms at your sides.
This is a fundamental gymnastics position that builds tremendous core strength.
